top_signals.title: Analysis: Fed Chairman Warsh's credibility in question after leaving interest rates unchanged
top_signals.summary: The Fed held interest rates steady, but long-term Treasury yields jumped. Investors are questioning whether he will act forcefully enough on inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Todd Blanche AG nomination vote by Senate Judiciary postponed amid Trump-IRS settlement concerns
top_signals.summary: Sen. John Cornyn, R-Texas, says the DOJ has failed to satisfy his concerns about a deal to shield President Donald Trump and others from IRS tax audits.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
